$description: Not in Figma: our Figma export has no size variables. Written by hand (DTCG); npm run tokens:pull never touches this file, npm run tokens:build merges it with the Figma tokens into src/tokens.css. Values are the sizes the components already draw: icons, control heights (fields and the default Button are 36, docs/DECISIONS.md) and avatars. Each name is its value in px.

12.$description: The smallest glyph: a tag's remove ×, a tick in a small mark.

14.$description: Icons in dense rows and small controls: a disclosure chevron, a list row's marks, a filter chip's icon.

16.$description: The default icon: in buttons, icon buttons, menus, options, cards and fields.

18.$description: Navigation and status icons: the side nav, a search field's magnifier, a toast's status mark.

20.$description: A standalone icon with room around it: a modal's close ×, a drop zone, the icon gallery.

24.$description: The largest UI icon: an alert dialog's badge, an image placeholder, a side nav icon slot.
The smallest square button: a banner's or toast's dismiss ×, a rich text toolbar button.

28.$description: Compact controls: the default icon button, a modal's close, a card's chevron, a toast action, a toggle in a group.

32.$description: Small controls and rows: Button size 32, Compact button, Segmented control, menu, tree and list items.

36.$description: The default control: text, date and number fields, Select, the default Button, a side nav row. Fields line up with buttons beside them.

40.$description: Large controls: a field inside a card, a folded side nav item (a square hit area).

16.$description: A face inside a dense row: an assignee in a list row.

24.$description: Avatar groups (overlapping faces) and the side nav's account row.
